description: KL320 counts the mods checked together: each fits alone, 480 together do not. Both are told.

diagnostics.message: Together, the mods checked here ask for 480 new VFX, and the game has room for 473 (2048 less its 1575): past a limit the game aborts, so Kiln refuses the mod that reaches it and none of its VFX load
